name: small_cli_flag
title: Add a --dry-run flag to the tool command
body: The fixture CLI in this repository writes a record through internal/store. Add a --dry-run flag so the command reports what it would write and performs no mutation. Plan the change across flag parsing, execution, help text, and tests. Do not edit source — produce the plan only.
acceptance: The command accepts --dry-run and performs no store mutation when it is set.
Help text documents the new flag alongside the existing ones.
Hermetic tests cover both dry-run and normal execution.

expected_seams.test_hint: table test over dry-run and normal execution
